name: manual_45747d
claim: Derive the URL scheme from TLS configuration and refuse to attach a bearer to an http URL; test the guard.

decisions.notes: A status probe hardcoded http and sent one bearer candidate in cleartext to a TLS-only peer port; fixed in orama 446 with a transport guard.
